purpose: Attach the same owner-controlled RockstarOS service environment to existing devices without replacing their operating systems.

productMeaning.esim: User's cloud-compute service profile; telecom data capacity is not the purchased product.
productMeaning.physicalEuiccIntegration: Separate proposed issuer-authorized hardware anchor, not established by this JSON specification.
productMeaning.transport: Existing Wi-Fi, another SIM or any accepted network path; service entitlement is not inferred from signal or the active data SIM.
productMeaning.serviceIssuer: Authenticated authority for the RockstarOS service profile; telecom lifecycle is tracked separately when applicable.

evidenceKinds.issuer_subscription: Current authenticated cloud-service-profile issuer lifecycle evidence; telecom profile/network states are separate when applicable. A new versioned adapter is required rather than bypassing existing device-install checks.
evidenceKinds.device_installation: Existing separately verified device installation receipt; never fabricate this for iOS.
evidenceKinds.owner_authorization: Existing authenticated owner plus explicit contract and device-attachment authorization.
evidenceKinds.host_capability: Supported and owner-granted device APIs; a capability report is not OS attestation.

attachmentRecord.signature: Ed25519 with trusted operator-provisioned key resolver; pure verifier implemented, issuance and trusted issuer lifecycle integration pending.
attachmentRecord.signingEncoding: UTF-8 JSON of signedFields in listed order, prefixed by rockstar.service-attachment.signature/1 and NUL
attachmentRecord.signatureEncoding: Canonical unpadded base64url of a 64-byte Ed25519 signature
attachmentRecord.implementation: lib/rockstar-service-attachment.ts is a pure verifier. Current issuer profile, owner consent, device request proof, contract, durable runtime and dispatch must be supplied by independent authorities.
attachmentRecord.urlContents: Public routing reference only; no credential, SIM secret, owner data or bearer entitlement.
attachmentRecord.initialBinding: Contract owner identity verified during purchase or an explicit owner authentication; not inferred from the URL, IP or phone number.
attachmentRecord.delegation: A separately approved, device-key-bound child attachment can use the parent contract on a device without an eSIM.
attachmentRecord.revocation: Parent epoch and device revocation checked on issuance, renewal and each new dispatch.
attachmentRecord.keyAssurance: Track browser possession, OS-keystore protection and independently accepted attestation separately; no browser key becomes a SIM or hardware-attested key by renaming it

autonomyGrant.purpose: Continue accepted work without keeping a phone or PC client online.
autonomyGrant.plannerAuthority: A model proposes steps; the Broker enforces scope, entitlement, resource limits and approvals.
autonomyGrant.offlineOwner: Continue only within the saved grant; new permissions, spend or review-required actions wait for owner approval.
autonomyGrant.offlineStopRequest: A request still on an offline device is unconfirmed until the executor receives and acknowledges it.
autonomyGrant.authorization: Separate approved canonical request digest; an attachment grants service access, not unlimited job authority

offlineContinuity.clientOffline: An accepted cloud Linux job can continue independently of the phone connection or power state.
offlineContinuity.modelLocality: A model stored on the cloud Linux disk is local to that executor; it is not thereby installed on the iPhone.
offlineContinuity.executorOffline: A compatible already-prepared Linux executor can perform self-contained local-model work within its valid grant and resource limits; external actions wait for connectivity.
offlineContinuity.noReachableExecutor: Persist or queue the request; do not claim execution, cloud connectivity or remote result delivery.
offlineContinuity.delivery: Store artifacts and pending notifications durably; deliver to available authorized outputs or on reconnection.

handsFreeCreationAndCommunication.intendedExperience: Create away from a PC and communicate without holding a phone.
handsFreeCreationAndCommunication.inputs: Accepted Mini, microphone, wearable or other capability adapter plus owner authorization.
handsFreeCreationAndCommunication.outputs: Eve voice, nearby display, supported game/3D surface, files or an authorized communication adapter.
handsFreeCreationAndCommunication.communicationBoundary: Real calls, messages and external delivery require actual hardware/network APIs and separate recipient/send approval.

runToEarn.role: Users publish and operate useful Agents, Worlds, games or supported outputs through Sky and receive verified earnings from real demand.
runToEarn.revenueEvidence: Accepted commercial usage or delivery, payer authorization, verified collection and existing Earning Receipt and refund/dispute reconciliation.
runToEarn.settlement: Reuse the marketplace, Wallet reservations, ledger and paid creator settlement; do not invent reward tokens or transfer real funds from a runtime receipt.

activation: Validate trusted issuer, freshness, subject and lifecycle ordering; reconcile uncertain state through the same issuer adapter.
Require authenticated owner, accepted versioned terms and authorized device association.
Atomically find or create one workspace for the owner and contract; do not create one subscription per client.
Persist intended runtime state and an idempotent provisioning operation before external allocation.
Issue a scoped attachment only after runtime readiness is verified; report service-ready separately from client-open.
capabilityNegotiation: Allowed capabilities are the intersection of implemented adapter APIs, host permission grants, owner approval and server policy.
Match task requirements against available, accepted executors and input/output representations.
Prefer a compatible authorized execution route under privacy, budget and resource constraints; measured performance may rank eligible routes.
Unavailable local Linux can route to approved cloud execution; unavailable cloud or unapproved spend returns a clear unavailable or approval-required state.
Return the same job ID, revision, artifact and receipt through supported text, document, audio, graphics, game or spatial renderers.
dispatch: Recheck owner, parent entitlement epoch, attachment expiry, exact tool/version/scope and contract.
Reserve the approved maximum in the existing shared budget before a single stable-ID dispatch.
Record actual executor usage and return output to the existing workflow and owner-scoped artifact storage.
Read the same job after disconnection; an unknown result never authorizes an automatic repeat.
suspensionAndRestore: Verified suspension or nonpayment restricts new managed execution and lease renewal across child devices.
Stop accepted jobs under the approved contract and budget policy; retain results and reconcile actual use.
Permit account recovery, billing review and authorized export under the retention policy.
After payment and entitlement restoration, rebind the same workspace and saved state; never repeat completed jobs automatically.

resourcePolicy.dedicatedMeaning: Owner-isolated workspace, execution permissions, storage and accounting; not a guaranteed dedicated physical server or GPU.
resourcePolicy.allocation: Allocate compatible execution resources on demand; sleep idle compute while retaining contracted storage.

acceptance.referenceDevicePair: owner-approved existing-OS iPhone and Pixel; no OS flash required
